visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat brokerage testimonial walls and portal review widgets: every verified Google review on its month as a working strip, year chips that filter, full text in the served HTML, no aggregateRating on our own site, a door to a broker.
note: SITE-79 2026-09-10. Order is Breadcrumb, V3Proof AS THE WHOLE OPENING (score face first: 5.0 drawn as stars with the count and shadcn Avatar initials for recent reviewers — reviews table has no photo column; H1 is sr-only so the rating is not printed twice; one client quote in full; Call/Book after the quote; packed year-axis strip + year chips; archive disclosure), then V3Doors #next. Quiet reach above the proof is GONE. Catalog: house-proof, house-doors, shadcn-avatar via installById.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > Reviews. Surface tone. Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: V3Proof
requiredComponents.section: The page. headingLevel 1. `face`: the Google score plate (average drawn as stars, the count) instead of a five-tile figure row; the remaining figures render as a context caption. `actions`: the reach as one slim row under the score and the lead quote — never before them. `archive`: the lead reading pane above the strip, then the strip of every review on its month, the year chips, and a native disclosure holding every quote in the served HTML. Source is the Google reviews URL. record stays on so the strip is honest against the count figure.

requiredComponents.name: V3Doors
requiredComponents.section: Four next steps: write, broker profiles, homes for sale, Value my home. Replaces the three-row Ledger plus Quiet edges, which stacked another list under the instrument.

deferredComponents.name: V3Ledger
deferredComponents.reason: A three-row next-step ledger under twenty-five cards was a stacked-section page. Doors carry the same four destinations.

deferredComponents.name: V3Instrument
deferredComponents.reason: Proof is the record. A second figure row would restated the same count.

removedComponents: Twenty-five always-open quote cards as the page (2026-09-03). Full text remains in HTML under the archive disclosure.
V3Quiet #edges — Google URL is the Proof source; Value my home is a door.
sectionOrder: V3Proof #reviews -- score face, context figures, lead quote, reach row, strip, year chips, archive disclosure

tasteReview.evaluator: separate grok-4.6 via cursor-cli (scripts/taste-evaluate.ts), SITE-109 reviews Tip Ready Mini — three scorings of tip fb0158a30 shots (default + avatar-open)

shotSpec.capture: first viewport, tip fb0158a30 cloud recapture (AvatarGroup catalog portraits; avatar-open = reviewer dropdown Read this review / View on Google / All reviews — SaaS Sign Out gone)

tasteReview.beats: Google Business Profile reviews UI (google.com/maps): this page wins on first-read of the full quote in display type rather than a truncated snippet, and on encoding all 25 reviews as year marks instead of a paginated handful. It loses on reviewer identity.

defects.finding: The three stacked faces are the catalog demo's own portraits (illustrated GitHub avatar, stock headshot, dark mascot), not Google reviewers. MJB is labeled next to a cartoon that is not MJB. The job is reviewer portraits if we have them; public.reviews has none, so AvatarFallback initials is the honest Avatar object, not pasted demo people.
At 375px the chip row clips the 2019 count off the right edge, so the oldest year is not operable in the first viewport. Desktop shows All 25 through 2019 4; mobile stops at 2023 3.

The strip is a field of identical navy dots under the caption 25 marks on the timeline. One mark is darker; nothing in the first viewport reveals the review behind a mark. A beeswarm that does not show the quote on hover or focus is a mute chart.

These shots cannot show a title, JSON-LD, or visible H1, so SEO did not evidence an increment. Inventory on the fold is the 5.0, the 25-count, year totals, and one full quote — held, not visibly improved, which this loop treats as a miss.

priorMark.shotsHash: not recorded — the cross-class table predates per-row shot hashes

tasteReview.rebaselineReason: Tip Ready Mini rejudge on tip fb0158a30 (reviewer-identity avatar-open) after 39f818bfc SaaS Sign Out miss; same grok-4.6 cursor-cli instrument. Landed on Matthews Mini.
tasteReview.verdict: demoMatch is true: the avatar-open shots are AvatarGroup plus a dropdown on an Avatar trigger, navy on cream, not a cream box that hid the control. The opening is house-proof (5.0, stars, 25 Google reviews, one client's words in full) with Call and Book after the quote, not a Quiet reach list. What fails is honesty and dull remainder: catalog-demo faces standing in for MJB, a 375px year row that clips 2019, and a beeswarm that does not reveal a review. SEO did not improve in these pixels; inventory is held (count, years, full quote), not raised.
tasteReview.dullest: The year-chip keypad over a mute swarm of same-size navy dots. The quote already did the work; the instrument under it is a filter strip and a caption pretending the dots are a story.
tasteReview.contactListAnswer: The fold opens on 5.0 as stars, the count, and one client quote in full; Call and Book sit after the quote. V3Doors closes the page.

contentFloor.note: No-regression floor (ci:route-content-floor). A build under any number here fails before the evaluator runs. Lower a number only by hand, in the same commit, with the reason.
